- Orange juice, about 300 ml: 135 kcal, 31 g carbs, 2 g protein.
- Lemonade or apple juice, about 250 ml: 110 kcal, 28 g carbs.
- Fruit bowl (watermelon, cantaloupe, strawberry), about 200 g: 65 kcal, 16 g carbs, 1 g protein.
- Grilled cheese sandwich, possibly with ham: about 400 kcal, 15 g protein, 32 g carbs, 22 g fat.

That gives about 710 kcal served. I assumed about 60 kcal left over, so roughly 650 kcal eaten.
